title: Desktop To Mobile
description: A single interface appears across desktop, tablet, and phone viewports so the responsive system reads as one coherent product.

defaultProps.title: One system, every screen
defaultProps.subtitle: Show how the same product adapts from a wide workspace to a focused phone flow.

title: Fluid Breakpoint
description: A viewport smoothly narrows along a breakpoint ruler, making fluid interpolation and layout thresholds visible.

defaultProps.title: Design for the in-between
defaultProps.subtitle: Make responsive behavior legible before a breakpoint becomes a bug.

title: Grid Collapse
description: A six-card grid collapses from four columns to two and then a readable stack with continuity-preserving motion.

defaultProps.title: Keep the hierarchy
defaultProps.subtitle: Demonstrate how a dense card system preserves priority as available width disappears.

title: Nav To Menu
description: Full desktop navigation morphs into a compact mobile menu while the brand and page context stay anchored.

defaultProps.title: Navigation without compromise
defaultProps.subtitle: Show the moment a full navigation system becomes a focused menu affordance.

title: Card Reflow
description: Three content modules move from a horizontal desktop row into a full-width mobile stack without losing their order.

defaultProps.title: Order survives the reflow
defaultProps.subtitle: Animate content modules into their narrow-screen reading order with clear spatial continuity.

title: Typography Scale
description: A hero headline transitions from display-scale desktop type to a compact mobile lockup with an explicit size ruler.

defaultProps.title: Type that fits the moment
defaultProps.subtitle: Make fluid type decisions visible, legible, and easy for an agent to reuse.

title: Image Art Direction
description: A wide desktop image treatment crossfades into a deliberately art-directed mobile crop rather than simply shrinking.

defaultProps.title: Choose the right crop
defaultProps.subtitle: Show why responsive imagery needs a focal point, not only a smaller box.

title: Sidebar To Drawer
description: A persistent dashboard sidebar slides away and becomes a compact drawer control while the content canvas expands.

defaultProps.title: Give content room
defaultProps.subtitle: Demonstrate a navigation rail becoming an overlay drawer on a constrained viewport.

title: Table To Cards
description: A dense desktop data table transforms into readable status cards for a phone-sized viewport.

defaultProps.title: Data that stays readable
defaultProps.subtitle: Show the semantic transformation from columns to compact records instead of forcing a squeeze.

title: Responsive Scrub
description: A responsive preview repeatedly travels across widths with a visible scrubber, useful for presenting a design system in motion.

defaultProps.title: Scrub the whole system
defaultProps.subtitle: A compact viewport journey gives agents a reusable way to present responsive behavior end to end.
